meta.title: Audioask — Get more from your podcasts.
meta.description: Audioask takes your podcasts to the next level. Listen, transcribe, and ask AI questions about every episode — and actually use what you listen to.

features.title:
A real podcast app,
built for people who actually listen.
features.lede: The small features that turn your podcasts into something genuinely valuable.
features.dividerLabel: The features that make the difference

search.title: Search that finds everything, everywhere.
search.text: Type a word, an idea, a name. Audioask takes you straight to the right passage — across all your transcribed or bookmarked episodes.

transcribe.title: Audio to text in just a few minutes.
transcribe.text: Audioask transcribes your episodes with timestamps and speaker identification. Read, search, share — every word is searchable in minutes.

ask.title: Ask questions. Get answers from any episode.
ask.text: In plain English, in any language. AI answers with timestamped citations from the transcript — verifiable in one click.

prompts.title: Your favorite prompts saved and ready to reuse.
prompts.text: Save the questions you ask all the time — "summarize in 5 points", "what are the key quotes?". One click, and AI answers on the episode with citations.

automate.title: New episodes processed automatically. While you sleep.
automate.text: Activate automation on a channel: every new episode is transcribed, analyzed, and delivered where you want it. Library, email, Slack — your choice.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks to flag the moments worth revisiting.
bookmarks.text: One tap while listening, and the moment is pinned with its timestamp. Re-read, share, or export your bookmarks — in the transcript and in your library. On web and mobile.

transcribe.title: Transcribe
transcribe.text: Audio to structured text in minutes.

ask.title: Ask AI
ask.text: Ask questions, get answers — with citations.

automate.title: Automate
automate.text: Every new episode processed and delivered, hands-free.

translate.title: Translate
translate.text: 12 languages, translated transcript and dubbed audio.

library.title: Turn your podcasts into a real knowledge base.
library.lede: When one member transcribes an episode, the whole community benefits. You get instant access to thousands of already-transcribed episodes — without spending a single credit.

pricing.title:
Start for free.
Upgrade to €3 when you want more.
pricing.lede: No commitment. No credit card to get started.

pro.title: Want to use Audioask like a·pro?
pro.text: If you transcribe more than 10 hours per month, analyze entire channels, or produce deliverables from podcasts, the Pro plan is made for you.
